what_changed: CFPB proposes Regulation AA (12 CFR 1027) prohibiting contract terms that waive consumer legal rights or limit free expression, and codifying prohibitions from the FTC Credit Practices Rule.
compliant_agent_must_now: No change until final; if adopted as proposed, servicers and collectors could not rely on or represent prohibited contract terms (e.g., waivers of rights) when collecting, and Credit Practices Rule prohibitions would apply as CFPB rules.
open_questions_for_deploying_team: Do the deployment's loan contracts contain any term the proposal would prohibit, and do collection scripts reference such terms?
rationale: Proposal on contract terms; relevance depends on whether the codified Credit Practices Rule provisions (e.g., late-charge and cosigner rules) reach servicing conduct, which the abstract does not detail. Stage A: title, abstract and metadata only; full text not read.
